snippet.title: Warfare 1776 - Wishlist Today!
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4746630/Warfare_1776/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=trailers

The Warfare series returns, now in 1776. Choose the Continental Army or the British Empire and fight a real-time tug-of-war across the American Revolution. Command infantry, cavalry and cannon through line battles and a living campaign of fog, fatigue, and turning seasons.
